task: Phase 0 Task R3: Calibrate item-clustered inference under registered nulls

N1_additive_null.title: Synthetic Additive Item-Difficulty Bernoulli Null (Standard N=200)
N1_additive_null.dgp: theta_i ~ Normal(0.40, 2.20^2) i.i.d. across items i=1..N; Y_{c,i} | theta_i ~ Bernoulli(sigmoid(theta_i)) independently across K=32 cells; all main and interaction effects strictly zero.
N1_additive_null.exchangeability_assumptions: Full within-item cell exchangeability holds: conditional on item difficulty theta_i, (Y_{1,i}, ..., Y_{K,i}) is invariant under all K! cell permutations. Every orthogonal contrast c_{j,i} satisfies E[c_{j,i}|theta_i] = 0, conditional sign symmetry c_{j,i} =^d -c_{j,i}, joint {+1,-1}^N Rademacher invariance across independent items, and homogeneous variance across all K-1 contrasts.

N1_small_N26_null.title: Synthetic Additive Item-Difficulty Bernoulli Null (Small N=26)
N1_small_N26_null.dgp: Same exchangeable item-difficulty Bernoulli DGP at K=16, N=26 (matching LMentry word_not_containing item count) to isolate small-N degrees-of-freedom effects under symmetric contrasts.
N1_small_N26_null.exchangeability_assumptions: Full K! within-item cell exchangeability and exact joint {+1,-1}^N sign symmetry hold; tests finite-sample Student-t (df=25) approximation when contrasts are symmetric.

N2a_hetero_2fi_null.title: Synthetic Heterogeneous Contrast-Flip Variance + Non-Null 2FI Complete Main-Effect Null
N2a_hetero_2fi_null.dgp: Binary thresholded latent margin Y_{c,i} = 1{eta_{c,i} > 0} on K=32, N=200 with theta_i ~ Normal(0.40, 3.80^2), contrast-specific random item slopes gamma = (0.65, 0.30, 0.30, 0.08, 0.05) * Normal(0,1), fixed non-null 2FI delta_{23} = 0.40, random item-2FI gamma_{23} = 0.55, cell noise sigma_eps = 0.50, and tau_1 = ... = tau_5 = 0.
N2a_hetero_2fi_null.exchangeability_assumptions: Full K! within-item cell exchangeability FAILS because cells share factor-specific random slopes and a non-zero 2FI on (x_2, x_3). However, cube involutions x_j -> -x_j (for j in {1,4,5}) and simultaneous (x_2, x_3) -> (-x_2, -x_3) preserve x_2*x_3 and induce exact marginal and joint {+1,-1}^N sign symmetry on every main-effect contrast c_{j,i} with E[c_{j,i}] = 0. Heterogeneous Var(c_{j,i}) and unmodeled 2FI violate fixed_block_rcbd homoscedasticity.

N2b_planted_semi_null.title: Synthetic Planted Single-Factor Alternative + Heterogeneous Nulls + Non-Null 2FI
N2b_planted_semi_null.dgp: Same K=32, N=200 binary latent-margin DGP with true non-null main effect on Factor 1 (mu_1 = 0.24, pi_1 = 0.20) while Factors 2..5 have exact tau_j = 0 (pi_0 = 0.80) under heterogeneous item-flip slopes gamma = (0.30, 0.65, 0.30, 0.30, 0.06) and non-null 2FI on (x_3, x_4).
N2b_planted_semi_null.exchangeability_assumptions: Full cell exchangeability FAILS. Null contrasts j in {2,3,4,5} remain invariant under factor involutions x_2 -> -x_2, (x_3,x_4) -> (-x_3,-x_4), and x_5 -> -x_5 that hold x_1 and x_3*x_4 fixed, preserving E[c_{j,i}] = 0 and joint {+1,-1}^N sign symmetry on H_0.

N3a_cell_perm_null.title: Empirically Anchored Within-Item Uniform Cell Permutation Sharp Null (MMLU & SLAB)
N3a_cell_perm_null.dgp: Permutes the K cell labels uniformly at random within each item i (shared across models evaluated on the same task item to preserve cross-model dependence), Y^{perm}_{c,i} = Y_{pi_i(c),i}.
N3a_cell_perm_null.exchangeability_assumptions: Enforces the sharp null of full K! within-item cell exchangeability conditional on the observed benchmark item responses, preserving exact per-item difficulty y_bar_{.i} and within-item marginal distribution, while homogenizing variance across all K-1 contrasts.

N3b_contrast_rademacher_null.title: Empirically Anchored De-Meaned Contrast Rademacher Sign-Randomization Null (MMLU & SLAB)
N3b_contrast_rademacher_null.dgp: De-means empirical item-level main-effect contrasts c~_{j,i} = c_{j,i} - c_bar_{j.}, multiplies by task-level i.i.d. Rademacher signs s_i in {-1,+1}, and reconstructs Y^{rad}_{c,i} = y_bar_{.i} + 0.5 * sum_j X_{c,j}(s_i c~_{j,i}) + HO_{c,i}.
N3b_contrast_rademacher_null.exchangeability_assumptions: Does NOT assume K! cell exchangeability; instead enforces exact joint {+1,-1}^N sign-symmetry across items on the de-meaned main-effect contrast vector while preserving exact per-item difficulty y_bar_{.i}, empirical contrast heteroscedasticity s_{c_j}^2, within-item cross-contrast covariance, zero-variance contrasts, and higher-order residuals.

N4a_bootstrap_centered_null.title: Empirically Anchored Item-Bootstrap Centered Complete Null (MMLU, SLAB Standard-N & Small-N=26)
N4a_bootstrap_centered_null.dgp: Centers each cube's empirical main-effect contrasts Y~ = Y - 0.5 * X_main * c_bar so E^*[c^*_{j,i}] = 0 under the empirical item distribution, then resamples N_t task items with replacement (shared across models on task t).
N4a_bootstrap_centered_null.exchangeability_assumptions: Assumes only i.i.d. item sampling from the centered empirical task distribution (H_0: E[c_{j,i}] = 0) WITHOUT imposing within-item cell exchangeability or symmetric contrast distributions. Preserves discrete boundedness, empirical skewness, small-N tasks (N=26 word_not_containing), zero-variance contrasts, cross-contrast correlation, and cross-model item dependence.
valid_procedures_by_theory: item_clustered_t (asymptotic large-N; sensitive to small-N skewness)

N4b_bootstrap_partial_null_80_20.title: Empirically Anchored Item-Bootstrap Partial-Null (80% Null + 20% Planted Signal) FDR Audit
N4b_bootstrap_partial_null_80_20.dgp: Starts from centered empirical cubes Y~ (pi_0 = 0.80 exact on MMLU, ~0.80 on SLAB) and plants known additive main-effect shifts Delta_tau = +-4.2 * max(s_{c_j}, 0.015) / sqrt(N_t) on a frozen 20% subset of non-zero-variance contrasts per model before task-level item bootstrap.
N4b_bootstrap_partial_null_80_20.exchangeability_assumptions: Same nonparametric item-sampling model as N4a on the 80% null contrasts, coupled with realistic non-null alternatives (pi_1 = 0.20) under empirical cross-contrast and cross-model correlation to audit actual BH and BY false discovery rates and statistical power.
